newsitem.title: USA: NYSE short interest sets record 2.94 bln shrs. [CORRECTED 08:30 GMT 22/2]
newsitem.headline: NYSE short interest sets record 2.94 bln shrs. [CORRECTED 08:30 GMT 22/2]

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Friday that short interest in February increased to a record high of 2.94 billion shares.
February's short interest increased by 134.5 million shares from January's 2.80 billion (corrects from 2.80 million), the exchange said.
The previous short interest record of 2.88 billion shares was set December 1996, the exchange said.
The exchange reports short interest, an indication of the number of investors that expect stock prices to fall, on a monthly basis.
